newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU protest to Belgrade against violence.
newsitem.headline: EU protest to Belgrade against violence.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo said on Tuesday he had protested on behalf of the European Union to Belgrade about escalating violence in the country, but he admitted that there was not a lot the EU could do about it.
"I protested on behalf of the Union via the Dutch ambassador," he told a European Parliament committee. "They seem to be entering a new phase now. Violence will make everything different."
But van Mierlo noted that the 15-nation bloc's influence on events in Serbia was limited. It already had a trade boycott, he said.
"The option for military intervention is more or less excluded. We are looking at political and diplomatic pressure.
"All we have left is to try to convince, to give moral support where it is needed and to see what we can do with the Americans."
